text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Hundreds of people attended an emotion-charged funeral service on Wednesday for three Indians killed in an arson attack in Bahrain on Friday.
- Bank of Bahrain and Kuwait allocates 250,000 dinars to build a pedestrian bridge in the capital Manama.
- Seven Bahrainis found guilty of setting fire to 13 private vehicles were jailed on Wednesday by the State Security Court.
- Twenty million shares of the Bahrain Islamic Insurance Company started trading on the Bahrain Stock Exchange.
- Aluminium Bahrain will invest 18 million dinars in 14 projects over the next two to three years.
- An international expert is to visit Bahrain to study a plan to develop the state's foreign trade.
- Bahrain's Emir issues a decree allowing nationals of the United Arab Emirates to own real estate in Bahrain.
